channel.title: Apache SkyWalking – Release
channel.description: Recent release posts from Apache SkyWalking

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · The AI Assistant: Ask Your Observability Data in Plain Language
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Horizon UI's new AI Assistant answers questions about your live system with the same charts, topology and tables as the UI — read-only, permission-scoped, and running on a cost-efficient model you bring yourself.

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · AI Assistant：用日常语言查询你的可观测性数据
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 新增的 AI Assistant 可以用和 UI 相同的图表、拓扑和表格回答关于 live system 的问题；它只读、继承权限，并运行在你自己接入的高性价比模型上。

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 17/17: Getting Started & Migration
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: The finale of the Meet Horizon UI series: install Horizon as a single env-driven container, point it at your OAP, and — if you're on the old UI — swap it in drop-in. Plus the OAP 10.x vs 11.x compatibility matrix: what works on the query port, and what needs OAP 11's admin host.

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 17/17：安装与迁移
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Meet Horizon UI 系列收官篇：用一个环境变量驱动的容器启动 Horizon，指向已有 OAP；如果你还在使用上一代 UI，也可以把 Horizon 平滑替换进去。文中还说明 OAP 10.x 和 11.x 的兼容边界：哪些功能只需要 query port，哪些需要 OAP 11 的 admin host。

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 1/17: SkyWalking's New Observability Console
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Introducing Apache SkyWalking Horizon UI — the next-generation web UI. A greenfield rewrite on the same OAP backend that you can observe, operate, govern, and customize, starting with a sidebar that mirrors your whole estate.

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 1/17：SkyWalking 新一代可观测性控制台
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: 介绍 Apache SkyWalking Horizon UI：它沿用现有 OAP 后端协议，重新设计前端控制台，让观测、运维、治理和定制回到同一个入口。

item.title: Apache SkyWalking 2025 in Review: Making BanyanDB Ready for Production
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: A review of Apache SkyWalking community work in 2025, with a focus on BanyanDB becoming the production-grade native storage for SkyWalking.

item.title: BanyanDB 0.6 版本发布：性能和效率的提升

item.description: 介绍 BanyanDB v0.6 的新功能以及与 Elasticsearch 的基准测试。

item.dc:creator: Kai Wan, Sheng Wu. tetrate.io
item.description: Introduce what's new in SkyWalking 10, including Service Hierarchy, Kubernetes Network Monitoring by eBPF, BanyanDB, and more.

item.dc:creator: Wu Sheng, tetrate
item.description: The integration of SkyWalking and Istio Service Mesh yields an essential open-source tool for resolving the chaos created by the proliferation of siloed, cloud-based services.
